Chapter 423: Chapter 3: Meeting the Galaxy Master (Please Subscribe)

“Galaxy Master?”

The crimson octopus Ao Du thought hard, and finally shook his head, saying, “Never heard of him.”

As part of the Peak Clans, he had heard of all the somewhat famous Eighth Layer Evolvers of the Human Civilization, especially the likes of Wanyang Star Lord and Nine Swords Star Master, invincible beings at the Eighth Layer, whose names were known to all.

But the Galaxy Master?

The crimson octopus Ao Du truly had not heard of him.

“Of course, you haven’t heard of him,” the massive flesh mountain glanced at Ao Du, “This Galaxy Master is a newly promoted Eighth Layer Evolver. His teacher is the Chikun Star Lord.”

...

“Chikun Star Lord?”

The crimson octopus Ao Du’s spirit was shocked.

Every single one of the invincible at the Eighth Layer controlled a unique Cosmic Force, especially a fearsome invincible being like Chikun Star Lord.

Even if he hadn’t seen him, there was no way he wouldn’t know of him.

“This Galaxy Master is quite famous, stepping into the Eighth Layer before a hundred years of age, he is the top genius of this generation of Human Civilization.”

The massive flesh mountain knew many pieces of information about Human Civilization. It wasn’t really considered intelligence, as the name of the Shisan Peak Master didn’t need any inquiring at all.

“An Eighth Layer under a hundred years old?”

The crimson octopus Ao Du’s expression was envious, “Most of the Human Civilization’s Evolvers are like ants, but their rare talents truly make me envious.”

The crimson octopus Ao Du, being a special lifeform, was at the Fifth Rank at maturity and could simply cultivate to step into the Sixth Rank. It didn’t know how many years it took to reach its current Eighth Layer.

But those top human talents had reached the heights where it resided in just a mere hundred or several hundred years.

Of course, as a special lifeform, the crimson octopus Ao Du’s combat power surpassed that of a human Evolver at the same level.

But the gap between the two was not too significant.

Below the Eighth Layer, human Evolvers were crushed by special lifeforms of the same level.

But after the Eighth Layer, upon opening up their Inner Worlds, the foundation of human Evolvers was transformed, eliminating the fear of most special lifeforms at the same level.

“I am just warning you to be a little more cautious these days. Human Civilization is not like the Shadow Tribe,” the massive flesh mountain said, “You’d better reduce the frequency of devouring Life Planets. Human Civilization values their planets quite a lot.”

“Hmph, I am, after all, an Eighth Layer special lifeform, coming from the Star Alliance. Would he, the Galaxy Master, really trouble me over a few mere planets?”

The crimson octopus Ao Du snorted coldly.

In reality, it had already planned to heed the advice of the massive flesh mountain and behave for the time being.

At least, it had to figure out what the disposition of this Galaxy Master was like. If he was as tolerant as the Shadow Tribe, then its future days would be very comfortable too.

“Star Alliance?”

The massive flesh mountain shook its head slightly.

The Star Alliance comprised special lifeforms that banded together to resist the Human Civilization Alliance and the Insect Race Alliance.

Special lifeforms, being scarce in number, simply couldn’t form the massive clans like the Human Race or the Insect Race. To contend with Humans and Insects, they could only unite with one another.

Of course, even so, the members of the Star Alliance were still not many, with most of them scattered throughout the universe.

…

“Our Star Domain is about to welcome a new master? Named the Galaxy Master? Will the name of this Star Domain also become the Milky Way Star Region?”

“This Galaxy Master has an incredible background, being the disciple of Chikun Star Lord and also the unparalleled genius of Human Civilization.”

“Ah, I hope that this Galaxy Master will treat us like the Shadow Tribe did, that would be good.”

“Not clear, every Star Lord of Human Civilization has a different temperament. If the Galaxy Master is cordial with us, of course, it would be a good thing.”

“Although the personality of the Galaxy Master is unknown, he is very young, so he should not have much desire to kill.”

…

Inside the Milky Way Star Region, various special lifeform clans and reclusive Different Species Lone Walkers were quietly discussing.

They had gotten along pleasantly with the Shadow Tribe, who had conceded many interests to stabilize them.

Now that a new master from Human Civilization had taken over this Star Domain, these clans and individual wanderers were naturally anxious, unsure of what awaited them.

The Lone Walkers and special lifeform clans had settled here for lengthy eons. If possible, they naturally did not wish to move.

This was also why they still hadn’t left after the Shadow Tribe’s retreat.

Regardless of who the master of this Star Domain was, as long as it didn’t target them, everything would be all right.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Lin Yuan stepped out of the great hall and entered the Layer A cosmic spaceship, ready to head for the Galactic Star Region.

“From today on, I’ll call you ‘Silver Galaxy.'”

Lin Yuan set the destination as ‘Milky Way Star Region’ and left the rest to the smart controls.

With the control intelligence of ‘Silver Galaxy,’ the entire journey was hardly a concern for Lin Yuan, who could freely choose the optimal route.

“Master, starting now, it will take five years to reach the Milky Way Star Region,” a sweet voice echoed in Lin Yuan’s ears, belonging to the control intelligence of the Silver Galaxy.

“Five years?”

“That’s fine.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Without the Silver Galaxy, if he had to take those standard cosmic spaceships, he wouldn’t think of reaching his destination in less than twenty years.

The performance of the Silver Galaxy didn’t just involve Wormhole Shuttle over large distances, but the cooldown between two Wormhole Shuttles was also not long.

Whoosh.

The Silver Galaxy turned into a black lightning bolt, instantly reaching the Star Platform of Chikun Main Star, then sailed deep into the Cosmic Starry Sky.

Finally, the space slowly rippled with fluctuations, directly engaging in Wormhole Shuttle.

Inside the Silver Galaxy.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Five years, which might be brief for other Evolvers, were extremely precious for cultivation in Lin Yuan’s eyes.

With his Against-Heaven’s Understanding of Enlightenment, five years were enough for him to make significant progress.
